constraints: All four path arguments are explicit and absolute. Entry is a built index.js/mjs/cjs inside this app out/main.
Profile, ledger and output are descendants of the campaign config parent. Output is new or empty and is disjoint from profile and ledger.
Marker has exactly the four agreed fields. Default app data, live profile lock, unsafe channel hostname/TLS and nonzero/non-synthetic price are rejected.
Stored chat and memory model route must be openai-compatible + synthetic-memory on explicit literal loopback HTTP port; no query, userinfo or hash.
Profile contains nonempty ready memory with pendingJobCount zero. Script only reads Pinia projection, not DOM navigation or mutation.
Two independent Electron PIDs use the same profile. PID and loopback listener ownership checked via CDP and existing macOS lsof.
Normal SIGINT and existing app shutdown handshake. Timeout forces only the owned process group and reports FAIL.
Proxy explicitly disables Chromium localhost bypass, forwards only the dedicated channel port, blocks all other browser requests. Metadata list requests are separate from inference attempts.
Generated inference attempts or changed ledger records cause FAIL. Child logs are byte counts/SHA only; proxy evidence never includes headers, bodies, query or userinfo.
remaining: Root rebuilds the app, creates the final populated settled synthetic profile, and runs actual two-process acceptance. This handoff does not claim runtime PASS.
